What peptides are, what the evidence actually shows, and what is approved, investigational or unregulated. item.title: Ep 9: Four in 100 GLP-1 stoppers had a heart event or died yearly, double those who continued, in…
item.description: Peptides Weekly Four in 100 GLP-1 stoppers had a heart event or died yearly, double those who continued, in observational records. What You Need to Know: In observational records, about four in 100 people a year who stopped a GLP-1 had a non-fatal heart attack, stroke, or death, roughly double the rate among people who stayed on treatment. That comparison comes from Italian diabetes-clinic data, not from a trial that assigned people to stop. ...
